releaseNotes:
- Multi-engine language tagging consensus (Quick vs. Detailed modes)
- Song locking system to protect against accidental deletion or cache clearing
- Serbian script toggle (Cyrillic vs. Latin) and finalized localizations for 40+ languages
- Infinite looping tab navigation with reordered Library and Search tabs
- Integrated tag search and categorized management refinements
- "Lock Missing Songs" online availability check for library maintenance
- Improved media notification interaction and batch action stability
